name: Bristleback
body:
School: transmutation; Level: antipaladin 3, cleric/oracle 4, inquisitor 3, magus 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Components: V, S
Casting Time: 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range: touch
Target: armor touched
Duration: 10 minutes/level
Saving Throw: Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance: yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You call forth one of the best defenses known to history—a good offense—and manifest it on one suit of armor, causing it to bristle with spikes. The armor gains armor spikes, which have an enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to +1 per 4 caster levels. If an orc, ogre, or evil outsider casts this spell the armor spikes also have the flaming special quality.
